title: Father the trumpeter, brother Vic, French family name, sister
summary: His father played trumpet, brother Vic played tenor, the family name is French (father born near Paris), and his sister played piano.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: What about your father? Did he play any instrument?
My father played trumpet, played good trumpet.

Well, no, he played the Tokyo Gardens out at West End at concerts and stuff. And then my brother Vic, who's two years younger than myself, was a real good tenor man. He took up tenor. In fact, he's got lessons from Skag and Leon. Skag was one of good clarinet players and saxophone men in the late 20s.
Is he the one that played violin too? Did he? No, rap played violin.
Rap started on violin. I don't remember Skag playing violin, but rap originally started on violin.
One thing to interrupt. How do you pronounce your name exactly, and what is it, French or what?
Well, it is French. My daddy was born about maybe 25 miles out of Paris, France.

He was born in France. Came over and they'd pronounce it different ways. Merez, and if you're in the north, they say Merez. Yeah, how you did for it. Yeah, and Merez, and depends on who's pronouncing it.
But we're French people, and my mother's side too is Irish and French. And my sister played piano. My sister played real fine piano. In fact, Paul taught her all the chords and she liked it.
She was younger than you are.
